from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({D}), scl=Pin({C}))
A = 0x70
FONT = {'A': 0x00F7, 'B': 0x128F, '1': 0x0006, '2': 0x00DB, 'M': 0x0536, 'W': 0x2836}
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x21')
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x81')
i2c.writeto(A, b'\xEF')
ram = bytearray(16)
for i, ch in enumerate('MW12'):
    g = FONT[ch]
    ram[2 * i] = g & 0xFF
    ram[2 * i + 1] = g >> 8
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x00' + ram)
while True:
    time.sleep(1)
